Evidence Description: Provide the SDLC and change management policy
Provide a population of all changes deployed to production during the audit period
Provide IPE for the change population including parameters, row count, and system clock
For samples selected by auditor, provide change tickets showing approval and testing
Provide screenshots of password configuration settings
Provide a population of all new user access requests during the audit period
Provide IPE for the access provisioning population
For samples selected by auditor, provide access approval tickets
Provide a population of all terminated employees during the audit period
For samples selected, provide evidence of access removal within 1 business day
Provide screenshots of firewall rules and security group configurations
Provide the security incident response policy and plan
Provide a population of all security incidents during the audit period
Provide vulnerability scan reports for sample months selected by auditor
Provide evidence of annual vendor risk assessments for critical vendors
